Full human surface used in the anatomical orientation quiz
=========================================================

Local file: human.glb (downloaded 2026-10-06)
BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan
BodyParts3D, copyright The Database Center for Life Science.
Original dataset: BodyParts3D version 3.0, FMA7163 (skin).
Original archive: https://doi.org/10.18908/lsdba.nbdc00837-000
Dataset mirror: https://github.com/Kevin-Mattheus-Moerman/BodyParts3D
GLB export: https://github.com/yamz8/human-body-simulator/blob/main/public/models/anatomy-skin.glb

See HUMAN-LICENSE.txt and HUMAN-LICENSE-legalcode.html alongside this file.

The exporting project reports Draco optimization, coordinate registration
and semantic FMA grouping. This app preserves the downloaded GLB bytes;
it changes scale, material and vertex normals at runtime and adds separate
arrows, planes and a tissue cutaway. The model and adaptations remain under
CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan. Unrelated application code is not relicensed.
